newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end steady, Cimpor dominates.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end steady, Cimpor dominates.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Portuguese shares ended steady in light trade, with activity in Cimpor, BCP and PT accounting for 67 percent of total turnover of just 1.55 billion escudos.
* Dealers said they expected higher turnover tomorrow due to a likely increase in orders from banks.
* Apathetic trade on Lisbon bourse in recent sessions is explained by the rise of foreign markets and the forthcoming flotation of Deutsche Telekom, dealers said.

"The rise of foreign markets means investors are ignoring the local market in order to make more money elsewhere, and the flotation of Deutsche Telekom is cutting back trade in Portugal Telecom (PT)," said Jose Freire, analyst with broker Eser.
PT, traditionally one of the most liquid stocks on Lisbon bourse, could trade heavily again after the flotation of Deutsche Telekom due on November 18, analysts said.
PT closed at 4,045 escudos, down five, in volume of 97,122 shares.
